# Mike Shoss — Personal Website

## About
Mike Shoss is a founder, product executive, and builder of AI-native systems based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. He has 15+ years of experience in product and software, 10 patents in AI and video commerce, and has supported over $150M in fundraising outcomes.

## Current Roles
- Head of Studio & Principal Product Manager, AI & Ecosystem at Caseware
- Founder & Principal at Epilogue (AI Consulting & Product Studio)
- Founder & President at ShossX
- Founder at Milton Innovation

## Companies

### Epilogue
AI company focused on turning complex business problems into practical, high-impact AI solutions. Products include:
- Parleh: AI meeting companion that turns notes into live action and agent-triggered execution
- Fractal: AI-agent-driven product-truth platform (Closed Beta)
- TrustFlow: AI-powered administrative workflow automation (Invite Only)

### ShossX
Product-centric holding company focused on building and scaling ventures through AI, product strategy, and execution.

### Milton Innovation
Coming soon.
